nodes.label: Gas Efficiency
nodes.rationale: Pay gas once instead of N times by batching multiple transfers into a single transaction.

nodes.label: Non-Custodial Design
nodes.rationale: Tokens are forwarded directly from user wallet to recipients; contract never holds or controls assets.

nodes.label: Atomic Execution
nodes.rationale: Every send is atomic — either all transfers succeed, or the entire transaction reverts.

nodes.label: Automatic ETH Refund
nodes.rationale: Contract automatically refunds excess ETH back to sender after distribution.

nodes.label: Exact Approval Strategy
nodes.rationale: Requested approval for ERC20 tokens is limited to the exact amount needed for the specific batch, minimizing risk.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: Version has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure may all differ from training data.

nodes.label: Graphify Project Rules
nodes.rationale: Prefer graphify tools for cross-module questions as they traverse extracted and inferred edges; use report for architecture overview and wiki for navigation.

nodes.label: MultiSender DApp
nodes.rationale: Entry-point documentation describing the Next.js project setup, development workflow, and deployment on Vercel

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Instructs AI agents to use graphify for codebase navigation and to keep the graph updated after code changes

nodes.label: Agent Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Provides consistent instructions for different AI agents including graphify usage and graph-first navigation
